[[Viridian City]]
[[Team Rocket airship]] }} '''Surprised by Sneasel''' is the 289th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 22nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''Viridian City in Mind''' (Japanese: '''心の奥のトキワ''' ''{{tt|Tokiwa|Viridian}} in the Heart'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As he flies on [[Blue's Charizard]], {{adv|Red}} looks back at the [[Trainer Tower]]. {{adv|Blue}} looks back at Red and tells him to go on ahead in his mind. Red realizes that Blue gave Charizard to him because [[Aero]]'s wings are still pierced from the battle with {{adv|Deoxys}}. {{adv|Mewtwo}} confirms Red's theory by informing him of what Blue told it earlier. Red puts his [[Pokédex]] in his pocket and tells Blue and [[Saur]] that he won't let their efforts be in vain. Back inside the Trainer Tower, Blue tells {{adv|Professor Oak}} that Red has already left. {{adv|Green}} tells him that [[Blasty]] managed to give Red his new Pokédex. Blue notes that he was lucky that he was able to get through the hole Blasty made with {{m|Hydro Cannon}} and not get trapped with the {{adv|Deoxys}} duplicates. Since Green's Pokémon have immobilized the other duplicates that aren't trapped, they won't be causing trouble. Blue thanks Green for her help, while Green notes that since she had the hardest time, she was the most valuable person in the plan. She tries to give Blue his new Pokédex while he attempts to call her obnoxious as usual, but he falls to the ground in exhaustion. Since they're too tired to help, Blue states that everything is all up to Red. Back in the [[Viridian Gym]], {{adv|Yellow}} asks [[Silver's Sneasel]] why the statue of {{adv|Giovanni}} is in its memories. {{adv|Silver}} states that although he hasn't been there, he has memories of [[Viridian City]] buried into his heart. Recalling the moment when Green had her {{p|Abra}} {{m|teleport}} him to safety, Silver remembered a city surrounded by a forest. He reveals that he later found out that Green's intention was to use her Abra's {{t|Psychic}} abilities to pry through Silver's mind and send him to his birthplace. After doing some research on what he saw, Silver decided to come to Viridian. Silver expresses delight at seeing that his assumptions were correct. He asks Yellow who the person on the bust is. Yellow tells him that it belongs to Giovanni, the original [[Gym Leader]] of the Viridian Gym and leader of [[Team Rocket]]. Yellow hears rustling coming from the [[Viridian Forest]] and goes outside to investigate. She calls out to {{p|Dodrio|Dody}}, who brings Yellow her straw hat. Silver asks Yellow what's about to happen. When Yellow asks what Silver will do know that he knows that he has a connection to Team Rocket, Silver states that he will ask Giovanni what their relation to each other is. Although he knows that he will be facing the boss of Team Rocket, Silver decides that he will fight him. They hear a sound in the air, so Silver puts on his [[Silph Scope]] to see it closer. He sees the [[Team Rocket airship]], which he notes saves him the trouble of finding Giovanni. Noting that this isn't the same group he fought in [[Johto]], Silver guesses that the group must be Team Rocket's elite. On the Team Rocket airship, Giovanni asks Deoxys that it found his son near the Viridian Gym. Although Deoxys remains silent, Giovanni decides to trust in its skills. Giovanni decides to go down and meet his son himself, but he suddenly collapses in pain. As he cannot go down at the moment, Giovanni tells [[Sird]] and [[Orm]] to go in his stead. They exit the airship through a small pod, causing Silver to note that they can't avoid a fight. Silver sends out his {{TP|Silver|Gyarados}} and has him fire off a {{m|Fire Blast}}. The pod dodges the attack and sends out a {{p|Banette}}, which attacks Gyarados with a {{m|Shadow Ball}}. Silver tries to have Gyarados heal its injuries with {{m|Rest}}, but Banette steals the move with {{m|Snatch}}. Silver tells Sird and Orm to come out of the pod and face him in person. Inside the pod, Sird uses a machine to determine that Giovanni's son is actually Silver. Sird and Orm exit the pod and tell Silver that they are there to pick him up. Silver demands to know where Giovanni is. Sird simply responds by introducing herself and Orm to Silver. Silver tells them that his business is with Giovanni alone and tells them to get him down there. Sird notes that Silver is stubborn like Giovanni, which is uncalled for as a leader. Confused at what Sird is talking about, Silver sends his {{p|Murkrow}} to attack, only for it to be easily tossed aside by Sird's Banette. Sird tells Silver to calm down, or else they will have to take him by force. Although Orm notes that Silver is important to Giovanni, Sird tells him that she won't hurt him. Orm sends out his {{p|Jumpluff}} while Sird suggests having a [[Multi Battle]]. Much to Yellow's shock, Silver agrees to the battle. ==Major events== * {{adv|Blue}} gets a new [[Pokédex]]. * {{adv|Giovanni}} attempts to see his son, only to suddenly collapse. * It is revealed that {{adv|Giovanni}} is {{adv|Silver}}'s father. * [[Sird]] and [[Orm]] go to take Silver to his father. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * [[Sird]] * [[Orm]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Aero]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}) * {{p|Wigglytuff}} ([[Jiggly]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Granbull}} ({{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Blasty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Ditto}} ([[Ditty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Clefable}} (Clefy; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Nidoqueen}} (Nido/{{tt|Nidory|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Abra}} ({{adv|Green}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Dodrio}} ([[Dody]]/{{tt|Dodosk|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Chuchu]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{OP|Silver|Sneasel}}) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{OP|Silver|Murkrow}}) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Silver|Gyarados}}; [[Red Gyarados]]) * {{p|Deoxys}} ({{adv|Deoxys|Adventures}}; {{DL|Deoxys (Adventures)|Organism No. 2}}/{{tt|Entity Two|Chuang Yi}}; {{form|Deoxys|Normal Forme}}; {{adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Banette}} ([[Sird]]'s) * {{p|Jumpluff}} ([[Orm]]'s) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, {{adv|Silver}} tells his {{TP|Silver|Gyarados}} to "sleep and recover" instead of telling it to use {{m|Rest}}.
